title: Share project
warningPrivacy: Anyone with this link can view all SQL code and structure in these tabs.
warningLength: This link is large (~{size} KB). Some chat apps (Slack, Discord, Zalo...) may truncate it.
blocked: Data exceeds browser safe URL length (32 KB). Cannot create direct share link.
blockedTabs: This project has more than {limit} tabs, so no share link can be created. Remove some tabs and try again; downloading a .sqllens file does not help either, because that format cannot hold more than {limit} tabs.
failed: Could not create a share link from the current data. Close this dialog and open it again.
downloadHint: You can send this snapshot file directly to others.

view.loadingHint: The data lives in the link itself and is only read on your machine.
view.missingBody: The part after # may have been cut off. Ask the sender to reopen the Share dialog and copy the full link again.
view.invalidBody: The link may have been truncated by a chat app, or it was created by a different SQLLens version. Ask the sender to send the full link again.
view.errorCorrupt: the data is invalid or was cut off
view.errorTooLarge: the link is over the 32 KB limit
view.errorTooManyTabs: the snapshot has more than 100 tabs
view.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select the text and press Ctrl+C
view.readOnlyNote: Read-only. The content comes from the sender and is read on your machine only.
view.forkError: Could not add this snapshot to your workspace
view.forkErrorQuota: Browser storage is full, so the snapshot was not added. Delete an old project and try again.
view.forkErrorStorage: Your browser is blocking local drafts (private mode?), so the snapshot was not added.
view.forkAgainBody: This snapshot was forked once in this browser. Add another copy anyway?
view.runTimeout: The statement ran past 1,500 ms and was stopped. Your machine is fine — press Run to try again.
view.runLoadFailed: Could not load the run engine: {message}
view.runEmptyTitle: This tab has nothing to run
view.runEmptyBody: The snapshot has no SQL in the open tab.
view.runNeedsSandboxBody: The share page runs PostgreSQL and SQLite on your machine only. To run a MySQL snapshot, add it to your workspace and run it in the lab after signing in.
view.runNoRows: The last statement returned no rows.
view.runTruncated: Showing {max} of {total} rows. The total still counts them all.
view.runSetup: {count} earlier tabs ran on the same session to build the tables.
view.runLocalNote: Runs in your browser. No SQL byte leaves your machine.

roomFork.title: Fork room to Local Sandbox
roomFork.description: Create an independent local copy on your machine to edit and run freely. No SQL data leaves your device.
roomFork.limitReached: Reached the maximum of {max} forked rooms ({count}/{max}). Delete an old forked project in your workspace before forking another.
roomFork.tooLarge: Payload exceeds the 512 KB limit ({bytes} bytes), offending tab: {tabName}. Trim the tab content before forking.
roomFork.storageUnavailable: Your browser is blocking local storage (private mode?), so the room could not be forked.
roomFork.quotaExceeded: Browser storage is full, so the room could not be forked. Delete an old project and try again.
roomFork.failed: Could not fork the room to Local Sandbox.
